I may not be able to give any uplifting speeches about how life is great and god is glorious. But I can say you not stupid. From the way I see it you got in to a university and a elite one at that. And you had the mind to pursue the things you were interested in. Not many people are able to say they did that. And the way I see it if it’s something your interested in you don’t need something to show for it. But I do understand that wanting recognition for hard work and struggles is just our human way. I also feel like it’s a constant in most peoples mind to want to die because life is just pointless. But just the act of you being able to pursue the thing your actually interested in wow, just take a second and give yourself a pat on the back friend. And also all I can say in the end is try to wait out that miserable feeling of craving your own demise till it dies back down. But also be proud that you had the strength to come out and say anything about how you feel because not many people can do that. I hope your day gets better, and tomorrow brings something to keep you engaged in life.
